artist.name: AGENT
artist.bio: AGENT is Smita Singh, a fashion designer, interior stylist and co-founder of Magnetic Fields Festival who lives in Goa. Raised on 80s and 90s funk, hip-hop and house, she hosted World Ocean on boxout.fm, a show of soulful, genre-hopping music from across continents.

eras.sound: Soulful, genre-hopping global sounds, tropical to tribal

rels.title: Now And Then (with Daulat and Kaleekarma)
